evidence: Matches the Tests label and modifies test/functional/feature_taproot.py to add test cases enabling script assets for qa-assets.
rationale: Adds explicit test cases for legacy script edge cases to feature_taproot to enable generating dumped test vectors for qa-assets. While the underlying code branches are already reached in Core and the test minimizer drops them, naming these edge cases (such as OP_CSV with negative operands and OP_IFDUP with non-minimal zero) fills gaps that tripped up alternative implementations and unblocks bitcoin-core/qa-assets#297.
